decisionsForAccounts: R/o: apportion invoice rounding into net economic value in exact paise, excluding zero-value FOC lines from the allocation basis.
Frieght: retain as an excluded charge; do not assign freight to reagent revenue or purchase cost without an approved landed-cost policy.

Delivery Challan and Sales-Quotation: retain source identity and classification evidence; exclude from revenue, GP and invoiced supply to avoid counting both a preliminary document and its actual invoice.
A proposal, delivery record or invoice is not evidence of cash collection.
